snippet.title: Killing Floor 3 Operation Deep Freeze Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
An ice-covered, zombie-filled trailer from Tripwire Interactive debuted gameaply from Season 3 of Killing Floor 3, aptly-named Operation Deep Freeze. Operation Deep Freeze is introducing Wolverine-like claws and so much more, and you can hop in to Season 3 right now on PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430190/Killing_Floor_3/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
